obstacle.finding: Almost the entire niche publishes this material free.
obstacle.consequence: An affiliate asked to promote a $155 PDF against a wall of free, well-sourced content needs a real answer, not a pitch. Any recruitment copy that hides this will fail on first contact and burn the relationship.
obstacle.honest_answer_available: Free sources explain the obligations. None of the five found sells a static, regulation-cited implementation pack that a consultant can hand to a client as a deliverable. That is a narrow but real gap, and it is the only defensible claim.

recommended_segment: AI compliance consultants who need a client-facing deliverable, not more free reading
